name: ui-hit-confirm-reticle
title: Hit Confirm
description: Tâm ngắm đứng yên; lúc trúng, bốn góc lao vào tâm bằng lò xo rất nhanh, chân góc co lại và nét chéo mọc ra thành dấu X đổi màu nhấn, mục tiêu loé và rung nhẹ, nhãn "HIT" hiện.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-game-combat-hit-confirm, written here): px @320x200, reticle drawn ×1.5. Hit at 0.75 s, h = spring k700 d34 (~120 ms): four corners at 45° move radius 26 → 13 while their two 9 px legs shrink to 0 and 8 px diagonal strokes (2.5 px) grow inward, forming an X; colour light ink → accent past h 0.5; dashed circle r 26.5 fades in (80 % × h). Target flashes 70 % → 0 in 150 ms and shakes ±2 px 200 ms; 'HIT' label in 80 ms. Release 1.5-1.8 s outCubic (reverse). Params: hitAt: lúc trúng (0.75 s) · from / to: bán kính góc (26 → 13 px) · spring: lò xo (k700 d34) · releaseAt: lúc nhả (1.5 s). On a spring k700 d34 the four 45° corners close in, their legs shrink and diagonal strokes grow inward into an X that turns accent past halfway; drawn × 1.5.
moworks.titleVi: Tâm ngắm khép thành dấu X khi trúng
